Zeri|adc.identity: Very mobile physical and magic damage marksman. Her real attack is Burst Fire (Q), which fires 7 rounds at the first enemy hit and counts as an attack; her regular basic attack is a charged shot (passive Living Battery) that, once charged by moving and shooting, deals extra damage. Ultrashock Laser (W) slows the first enemy hit and becomes a long-range laser if it hits a wall, Spark Surge (E) is a dash that goes over obstacles and makes Burst Fire pierce for a few seconds, and Lightning Crash (R) releases a nova then overcharges her: stacking attack speed for each champion hit and Burst Fire firing in triple with chain lightning.
Zeri|adc.playstyle: Kiting ADC: she shoots while constantly moving and stays slippery thanks to her dash over walls. No clearly bad matchup: her weakest ones (Jinx, Tristana, Twitch) stay close to even. She crushes low-mobility poke ADCs (Ezreal, Varus, Miss Fortune).
Zeri|adc.early_game: Farm with Burst Fire (Q): it's your main attack. Save your charged shot to finish a minion or hit your opponent when it's fully charged. Poke with W, firing it at a wall to get the long-range laser. Keep E to dodge an engage.
Zeri|adc.level_1: Burst Fire (Q) is learned automatically at level 1. After that, the most played path takes Spark Surge (E) at level 2, Ultrashock Laser (W) at level 3, then Q.
Zeri|adc.level_2: Spark Surge (E). A dash that goes over walls and makes Q pierce: your mobility and your damage on the wave.
Zeri|adc.level_3: Ultrashock Laser (W). Slow and poke; against a wall it becomes a very long-range laser.
Zeri|adc.level_6: Lightning Crash: a damage nova, then overcharge. The more champions you hit, the more your attack speed goes up. Cast it at the start of a fight, then kite with E.
power_spikes: Level 2: E for trades and escapes.
First completed item: much more frequent Burst Fire.
Teamfights: triple Burst Fire with chain lightning.
Zeri|adc.lane_plan: Farm with Q, poke with W off walls, and play with your support. Don't waste E: it's your survival. The ADC role quest (300 gold, more gold per kill and per minion, then an extra item slot) rewards steady farming. Join dragons: your mobility lets you position there safely.
Zeri|adc.trading: Basic trade: Burst Fire on your opponent, then back off while still shooting. All-in: W to slow, E to stay in range, R, then nonstop Burst Fire. Avoid long fights against scaling ADCs (Jinx) and surprise engages (Twitch).
threats: Jinx, Tristana and Twitch: your weakest matchups, close to even.
Crowd control when your dash is on cooldown.
Engage supports who catch you before your overcharge.
mistakes: Standing still while shooting: Zeri has to keep moving all the time.
Wasting E to attack and having no way to escape.
Casting your ultimate with no champion to hit.

matchup_notes.Kai'Sa: Dodge her ultimate with E over a wall.
matchup_notes.Jinx: She scales: turn your lead into towers.
matchup_notes.Yunara: Avoid fighting her while her ultimate is up.
matchup_notes.Tristana: Save E to dodge her Rocket Jump.

Zeri|adc.mid_game: Group with your team and take objectives. Use E and W around walls to move and poke.
Zeri|adc.late_game: Kite nonstop behind your frontline, cast R as soon as several champions are in range, and use E to keep the right distance.
Zeri|adc.ahead: Force fights: your overcharge and mobility make you hard to stop.
Zeri|adc.behind: Farm, stay with your team and play teamfights by kiting.
Zeri|adc.win_condition: To win this game, you want to kite fights without ever stopping and clean up teamfights with your overcharge.
Zeri|adc.final_tip: Fire W at a wall: it becomes a very long-range laser, your best poke.
